correctness.rationale: An exact conjugate coordinate on the subcritical trapezoid gives the three interval branches. The induced rotation has return times one or two; coprime rational rotation orbits have \(p+q\) representatives, of which \(\lfloor q(s+r)floor\) are removed. The surviving points form one primitive return cycle. Integration of the rational height-residue polygons proves the endpoint half-weights, interior weights, total area and mean period. Riemann sums prove the high-denominator weak limit. The packaged exact-fraction verifier passed 6530 orbit samples, 3572 area polygons and 207445 branch evaluations; finite checks support rather than replace general proof.

value.rationale: The motivating map has a natural finite-area invariant trapezoid interpolating between two rotations. Its exact least-period histogram is a structural invariant answering which periods occur and how much planar area each occupies, along with a universal weak limit as rational parameters approximate irrationals. This is a complete parameter-uniform dynamical distribution, not a preselected numerical slice or routine single-orbit count.
